task_title: Fix Floor 1 staircase boss lock-in survival

plan_review.notes: Adversarial review compared planner-layer override, dynamic hysteresis/sticky add clear, and synthetic harness-first strategies. Adopted adjustments: bounded local crowd-count trigger (ARENA_LOCKIN_MELEE_CROWD_ADD_THRESHOLD) instead of unbounded count heuristics, immediate-threat-only survival override, sticky add target to avoid boss/add thrash, headless regression assertions that avoid reason-string parsing, and explicit negative BT coverage (boss remains target when add is not immediate).
